answer: Delayed-claim identity meter.** Each new agent identity must route a small transaction through a shared kernel that timestamps first activity and holds rewards for 30 days. A sonnet-length behavioral fingerprint (write cadence, query mix) is scored at day 30; clones scoring too similar to existing identities forfeit the held margin, while distinct agents keep it. Cloning costs the attacker the forfeited hold per attempt plus juniper-priced compute for fingerprint divergence—strictly negative-EV at scale.
